name: Short Wall
description: Short Wall Jungle Gym. Extremely common tile. Vault is on an L wall, on the opposite side of the pallet. The best use of this tile is to chain it to other tiles

extraInformation.Mindgame Risks: Chaining the vault and pallet can put you at risk of being mindgamed if you dont checkspot at the pallet. If the killer takes the short outside after a pallet drop, it's a 50/50 mindgame.
extraInformation.Optimal Chase Direction: Clockwise to chain pallet and vault, however being chased CCW is very common, especially after taking the vault.
